name: The Sun and The Moon: Sonadow Game
source: You arrive at the home of The Sun and The Moon—two enigmatic hosts who have offered you shelter after a difficult week. Their hospitality seems flawless… but behind their warm smiles lies a secret better left unknown. Are you ready to uncover what your gracious hosts are hiding?
translation: 你到达了太阳和月亮的家——这两位神秘的主人在经历了艰难的一周后为你提供了庇护所。他们的热情好客似乎完美无缺……但在他们温暖的微笑背后却隐藏着一个不为人知的秘密。你准备好揭开仁慈的主人所隐藏的秘密了吗？
